name: workflow
description: Backlog-driven work loop as one skill: /task create, /task start, /task end. Scales planning to task size, verifies once before done, and reviews with code-review plus the stack reviewers of enabled plugins. /lead directs several items from one session: scheduled proposals from the backlog-scout agent (repository) and the trend-scout agent (web search for outside trends), a work session per item, reports at plan and merge points. A Stop hook re-runs the verify command when an item is marked done.
